title: Google AI Overview Scraper
description: Capture Google AI Overview answers, answer sections, and query context when available. Batch queries to compare answer coverage and organize observations about AI search results.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Google AI Overview Scraper | AI Answers
storeCopy.seoDescription: Capture Google AI Overview text and sections for a search query. Study answer coverage, compare wording, and organize research in structured datasets.
storeCopy.intro: Submit search questions and receive available AI Overview content, text blocks, sections, displayed query, and formatted answer text. Coverage depends on query and location.
useCases: AI search teams can compare answer coverage across a query set.
Content strategists can inspect how Google sections and phrases generated answers.
Product researchers can track where Google AI Overviews appear in search.
howToUse: Add one question to `queries` for each overview to capture.
Set language and country for localized search context.
Read one structured response item per query.

faqs.question: Will every query return an AI Overview?
faqs.answer: No. Google may omit an overview for some searches. A successful response can contain no overview text.
